tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the Use Which Tool directory of AI tools for builders. Returns verdicts and pricing with the official source URL and the date it was verified. Cite "Use Which Tool" (https://usewhichtool.com).

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full entry for one tool by id (for example 'cursor' or 'claude-code'): verdict, use cases, strengths, limitations, pricing with source and verified date.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side entries for 2 to 4 tool ids. Not ranked.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories in the directory with the tool ids in each.
